entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Shri C.P. Singh, Counsel for State.

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C has been filed against FIR dated 02.08.2019 registered at Crime No.382/2019 at Police Station Ambah District Morena for offence under Sections 420, 272, 273 and 120 (B) of IPC and Section 51 & 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006.

It is submitted by Counsel for the applicant that during the pendency of present application, the charges have been framed, therefore, he may be permitted to withdraw this application with liberty to file revision against the order of framing of charges.
With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(G.S. Ahluwalia) Judge Aman AMAN TIWARI 2022.02.23 18:40:57 +05'30'
